description: Na₂K₂NdF₇ crystallizes in the cubic Im̅3m space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form face-sharing NaF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaF₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are three shorter (2.30 Å) and three longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are five shorter (2.44 Å) and four longer (2.48 Å) Nd-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Nd atom to form distorted FNa₄Nd trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra, corners with four equivalent FK₂Nd₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra, and edges with four equivalent FNa₄Nd trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent K and two equivalent Nd atoms to form distorted FK₂Nd₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with twelve equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₄Nd trigonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FK₂Nd₂ trigonal pyramid, and faces with two equivalent FK₂Nd₂ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-76°. In the third F site, F is bonded to three equivalent K, two Na, and one Nd atom to form distorted FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra that share corners with nine equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₄Nd trigonal bipyramids, corners with six equivalent FK₂Nd₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₄Nd trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent FK₂Nd₂ trigonal pyramids, and faces with four equivalent FK₃Na₂Nd octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-73°.
